title: Cell trace
description: A finite ordered sequence of cell-records sharing a common cell-projection — the layer-5 finitely-presented realization of a predication-cell-trace. Same-cell (r_i.cell = r_j.cell for all i, j), transaction-id monotonicity (r_i.t ≤ r_j.t for i ≤ j), and ≤_k-value monotonicity across r_i.value are runtime invariants the schema does not express.
